enemies.name: Warden Drone
enemies.note: Act I baseline. Indifferent, not malicious.

enemies.name: Warden Heavy
enemies.note: Armour makes fire rate matter less than damage per shot.

enemies.name: Warden Mote
enemies.note: Invisible without a scan relay — the reason cutting the relay has a cost.

enemies.name: Reach Breacher
enemies.note: Act II. Drains the bus while alive — the enemy attacks your economy directly.

enemies.name: Reach Sapper
enemies.note: Act II. Fragile, fast, and the largest single drain in the act. Kill it early or the whole board fires slower while it walks.

enemies.name: Reach Skiff
enemies.note: Act II air. Drains while it flies, so an unrevealed skiff costs power as well as ground.

enemies.name: Reach Bulwark
enemies.note: Act II heavy. Shielded and armoured, so an unrated weapon lands a quarter of its damage and then pays armour out of that — a pulse turret does nothing to it. The lance and the mortar do. At 8 armour and 430 HP it was immune to literally everything else and every anchor carrying it graded unwinnable.

enemies.name: Hollow Drift
enemies.note: Act III air. Reads on instruments as a pressure gradient, not an object.

enemies.name: Hollow Echo
enemies.note: Act III baseline. Screened by whatever it is made of rather than by equipment.

enemies.name: Hollow Vessel
enemies.note: Act III mid. Carries most of the act's drain and is not screened, so mass fire answers it.

enemies.name: Hollow Column
enemies.note: Act III heavy. Slow, screened, plated, and the single largest draw on the bus in the game.
